LAKSHYA ENGINEERING & CONSTRUCTION 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · West Bengal · IN 
 
 No. CC/49/2013/018 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Hospital Block - West Bengal Pkg-18"
 
 (buildings), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 
 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 
 22/03/2013 at a gross executed value of Rs. 9.80 Crore (Rupees 9.80 Crore Only).
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was
 taken over on satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Deepa Chatterjee. This
 certificate is issued for record and for submission with future tenders wherever
 the contractor is required to establish past performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Lakshya Engineering & Construction
